description: This PHP source file is part of the TestLink project. It handles bulk operations on test cases, including initializing page parameters, processing user input, and applying changes to multiple test cases concurrently. It interacts with the database, manages templates for display, and contains functions for setup and GUI configuration.

methods.name: init_args
methods.description: Initializes and processes incoming request parameters, setting default values and configuring test case attributes for bulk operations.

methods.name: initializeGui
methods.description: Prepares the graphical user interface configuration data based on provided arguments, for rendering the bulk operation page.
